metas.name: Fool Night
metas.description: In a dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of transforming into a Spirit Flower — a plant into which humans transform. Should he continue living as a person, or discard his pain and start a new life as a plant? Which path would you choose in his situation?

metas.name: Los Simpson
metas.description: La familia Simpson (Homero, Marge, Bart, Lisa y Maggie), y un reparto virtual de miles, viven aventuras cotidianas en Springfield, una ciudad estadounidense promedio.

metas.name: Toaru Anbu no ITEM
metas.description: In Academy City, psychic powers promise a brighter future. But beneath the city's peaceful surface lurks a merciless dark side. ITEM, an elite team of four girls with deadly abilities, carries out dangerous missions that can never see the light of day. When a fifth girl enters their lives, ITEM is drawn deeper into a world of violence, brutality, and moral corruption.

metas.name: Policías de Chicago
metas.description: El Distrito 21 del Departamento de Policía de Chicago está compuesto de policías uniformados, que tratan con la delincuencia callejera, y la Unidad de Inteligencia, ocupada de los delitos graves como el tráfico de drogas y asesinatos de alto perfil.
